body:
I've decided to close this PR that I made

I'm not against hashing the blinded outputs, and am happy for anyone else to advocate for this. It's just that I now have another solution ([Unpoisonable Blinded Outputs](https://gist.github.com/SatsAndSports/6c197ca9da984c1922483e74281d38db)) that fixes the poison issue directly, allowing us to keep using adverserial multi-party e-cash transactions (e.g. Spilman with non-interactive setup)
Folded into https://github.com/cashubtc/nuts/pull/404, which now carries `tests/14-test.md` with these vectors, the HTLC SIG_ALL case included.

Following offline discussions, a mint must manage rotation in a way that allows pending melts to complete before final deactivation. This PR now introduces error `12004` that a mint can return for a melt when a keyset is getting ready to rotate. Wallets seeing this error can retry with change outputs on a different keyset.

This PR ties up with #438, which will allow rotations to be tied to a published `active_until`, so wallets know in advance when a keyset stops taking new outputs and can avoid one that is about to rotate.
